instructions: Stand up straight with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in one hand, letting it hang down by your side.
Keeping your back straight and your core engaged, slowly bend sideways at the waist towards the opposite side of the dumbbell, lowering the weight as far as you comfortably can.
Pause for a moment, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides and repeat.
data.name: dumbbell side bend

reviewedInterpretation: 单手单哑铃，站姿向持重侧温和侧屈，使哑铃沿同侧大腿下移，再回直立；足与骨盆稳定，无旋转/前后俯仰。

references.clarification: Its own technique steps specify bending toward the loaded side while the weight lowers; no external pictures or animations were used.

reviewNotes: Pinned English step2 contains the same opposite-side/lowering contradiction as the translation.
Existing hold row in briefs.json is retained unchanged as historical initial review; this named source review resolves only direction for the new draft.
Only one side is illustrated; switching hands/sides is outside this pair.

movementBrief.startPose: 站姿中立直立，单哑铃在右手/画左大腿外侧自然低垂，左手轻扶左髋。
movementBrief.support: 双足全脚掌落地，骨盆近水平不侧移，尾巴自然在地后侧。
movementBrief.grip: 右爪稳握单哑铃，负重臂自然近伸直；另一手无负重。
movementBrief.jointMotion: 躯干向持重侧温和侧屈，头随脊柱，不只是歪头；髋膝不代偿屈曲，不前屈/后仰/转胸。
movementBrief.path: 右侧肩与负重手随侧屈下降，哑铃沿同侧外大腿降低，再沿原路回直立。
movementBrief.camera: 固定正前轻3/4宽景，能读肩线倾斜和重量高度变化，起终同机位。
criticalChecks: 只一手一只哑铃，不能双侧负重抵消。
须向持重侧下降，不能反方向弯却称重量降低。
足骨盆固定，不从踝整人倾斜，不仅颈部歪头。
全身、尾巴与DB均入画，强度与节奏不是训练处方。
